active-work.title: ⚡ Active Work
active-work.description: All active workstreams currently in progress, with real-time status and owning agent.
watch_for: Workstreams with no update in >8h (stalled)
Red blocker indicators on any workstream
Agent overload (1 agent owning too many)
actions: Expand a workstream to see task details
Assign a resource to an unowned workstream
Clear a blocker to restore velocity

blocked-work.title: 🚧 Blocked Work
blocked-work.description: All workstreams and tasks currently blocked, with SLA countdown timers and severity levels.
watch_for: SLA violations (timer turns red)
Critical severity blockers — these kill velocity
Blockers older than 24h with no owner
actions: Assign a resolver agent to the blocker
Escalate to founder if SLA at risk
Manually mark as unblocked when resolved

operator-guidance.title: 🎯 Operator Guidance
operator-guidance.description: AI-generated action recommendations based on live SSOT data analysis. Rules-engine driven, no hallucinations.
watch_for: HIGH priority items — these need immediate attention
Stalled work signals with no recent activity
Idle agents that could be reassigned
actions: Click 'Detail' on any item to drill into the issue
Act on HIGH priority items first
Use guidance to batch decisions efficiently

founder-decisions.title: 🧭 Founder Decisions
founder-decisions.description: Strategic recommendations for venture advancement and resource allocation, requiring founder judgment.
watch_for: High-confidence recommendations (>80%) — act on these
Ventures ready to advance to next gate
Kill recommendations — review carefully before acting
actions: Advance a venture to the next pipeline stage
Rebalance agent assignments across ventures
Trigger a kill review for underperforming ventures

insights.title: 🧠 System Insights
insights.description: Auto-computed patterns and anomalies detected across all SSOT data sources. Surfaces trends before they become problems.
watch_for: Velocity drops — completions trending down
Repeated blocker patterns on same venture
Agent health degradation signals
actions: Click an insight to drill into the affected area
Dismiss resolved insights to keep the list clean
Use insights to preempt blockers before they occur

opportunity-discovery.title: 🔭 Opportunity Discovery
opportunity-discovery.description: New venture and market signals detected by Moonshot agent. Shows incoming opportunity pipeline.
watch_for: High-signal opportunities with strong market evidence
Opportunities matching existing team capabilities
Time-sensitive market windows closing
actions: Qualify a strong signal into a new venture
Assign Moonshot to deep-dive a specific opportunity
Dismiss low-quality signals to keep list focused

momentum.title: 📈 Momentum
momentum.description: Weekly velocity trends — completions, launches, blockers resolved, and growth signals.
watch_for: Declining weekly completions (velocity drop)
Growth signals: high launch rate, rising completions
Blocker resolution rate falling behind creation rate
actions: If velocity down: identify bottleneck in Blocked Work panel
If momentum strong: double down on top venture
Share weekly momentum report with stakeholders

operator-impact.title: 🎯 Your Impact
operator-impact.description: Your personal operator metrics — decisions made, blockers cleared, ventures advanced, and velocity contributed.
watch_for: Decision backlog growing (>5 pending decisions)
Low blocker resolution rate
Ventures stalled without operator input
actions: Clear your decision queue in the Founder Decisions panel
Manually unblock items awaiting your approval
Review ventures awaiting gate advancement

agent-activity.title: 🤖 Agent Activity
agent-activity.description: Real-time feed of agent actions, task completions, errors, and status changes across all active agents.
watch_for: Agent errors (red entries) — may need restart
Idle agents with no activity for >2h
Unusual activity spikes — could be loops or retries
actions: Click an entry to see full task detail
Reassign idle agents to active workstreams
Investigate and resolve error patterns

workstream-flow.title: 🌊 Workstream Flow
workstream-flow.description: Pipeline stage distribution of all workstreams — from backlog through to completed. Shows flow health.
watch_for: Backlog pile-up (too many in early stages)
In-progress bottleneck (too many stuck mid-flow)
Zero completions this week
actions: Prioritize backlog items with highest venture impact
Break down large in-progress items blocking the pipe
Celebrate completions and update venture metrics

venture-pipeline.title: 🚀 Venture Pipeline
venture-pipeline.description: Full venture portfolio across all 8 VentureOS stages — from Idea to Live. Includes relationship graph.
watch_for: Ventures at kill thresholds (no progress)
Ventures ready to advance (gate criteria met)
Clustering in early stages (too many ideas, not enough MVPs)
actions: Click a venture to view full detail and advance/kill
Use gate advancement to push strong ventures forward
Review relationship graph for hidden dependencies
